Hi, I'm Dr Christopher Notley, Chiropractor and athletic therapist practicing in Winnipeg, Manitoba.  My practice combines the application of joint mobilization/manipulation, soft tissue release, acupuncture and therapeutic progressive exercise to help my patients get out of pain and back to being active.   Though I do treat a lot of backs, necks and headaches I also treat a variety of problems to the shoulders, elbows, hips, knees, etc. 

My channel is about educating people on how to take care of themselves.
